evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction error handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to distinguish I/O errors and pruned blocks from missing transactions.
rationale: Prevents RPC and REST endpoints from falsely returning 'transaction not found' when confirmed transactions cannot be read due to disk I/O errors or index corruption. Reviewer ryanofsky emphasizes that 'a confirmed transaction reported as missing is the wrong answer, and each path that turned an I/O or index error into "not found" now throws instead.'
